# ForgeOS by Fractional Forge
> The operating system for hardware startups. Expert knowledge, smart tools, investor intelligence, and manufacturing connections in one platform.

ForgeOS helps pre-revenue hardware startup founders (pre-seed to Series A) go from product idea to manufactured prototype without hiring a full engineering team.

## Core Capabilities
- 13 domain specialist advisors (strategy, engineering, manufacturing, finance, legal, sales, marketing, fundraising, product, HR, operations, supply chain, chief of staff)
- CAD Lab: generates STEP files, BOMs, DFM analysis, and engineering packages from product descriptions
- UK Supplier Marketplace: 13,700+ manufacturers and suppliers with automated RFQ generation
- Investor Intelligence: 7,800+ UK investors (VC, PE, angel) with matching scores and 49,000+ contacts
- 3,000+ grants database
- Business tools: objectives, tasks, cash burn projections, P&L, team management, board packs

## Pricing
- Explorer: Free (50 AI assists/month, basic marketplace access)
- Startup Team: GBP 49/month (100 assists, full marketplace, 13,700+ suppliers)
- Professional: GBP 149/month (500 assists, priority support, full investor intelligence)
- 14-day full-access trial, no credit card required
